title: Galician-Style Octopus Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from the Galicia region in northwest Spain, slow-cooking tender pulpo in a rich broth of warm spices.

ingredients.name: 1 kg pulpo
ingredients.amount: cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: 3 cloves garlic
ingredients.notes: a few threads of saffron can be added for extra flavor

instructions: Heat a large heavy pot over medium heat and add a small amount of olive oil.
Add the chopped onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the pulpo and cook for 5 minutes, until slightly browned.
Add the chopped cabbage, white wine, fish broth, smoked paprika, and saffron threads.
Bring the stew to a simmer and cook, covered, for 30-40 minutes, or until the pulpo is tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
